items.title: Researchers propose Zcash-style private Bitcoin transfers without a soft fork
items.summary: Shielded Bitcoin would use zero-knowledge proofs and encrypted notes to hide transaction details without changing Bitcoin consensus, but researchers have raised questions about anonymity and quantum resistance.

items.title: Bitget's $352 million hack happened via spoofed transfers, not private keys, CEO Gray Chen says
Block Adds Bitcoin Lightning to x402 Standard
items.summary: The Lightning payment specification has been merged into x402’s repository, while a Python implementation still awaits review and real-node testing.

items.title: Federal Reserve Unveils Stablecoin Rules on Reserves and Capital
items.summary: The central bank opened two proposals for comment under the GENIUS Act, requiring issuers it supervises to back tokens fully with safe assets and creating an application process for banks seeking to issue stablecoins.
